description: Get behavioral baselines for a tool category. Shows what 'normal' looks like — average latency, success rates, typical call patterns. Use this to evaluate whether a specific server's performance is within normal range for its category.

category.description: The tool category to get baselines for (e.g., weather, finance, code, data)

name: get_baselines

baselines_available.description: Whether enough data exists for baselines

metrics.description: Per-metric baselines with average, median, p95, min, max
